cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Sign up for the overnight shift if this project matters to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have you signed up?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'm keeping myself available for leadership decisions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: At three in the morning?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Apparently my test has reached a less comfortable definition of commitment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give up your prize seat to prove you're on my side.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you give up yours too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine is essential for maintaining perspective.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You mean watching comfortably.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I may have designed a test I wasn't planning to take.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you pulled the rope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Following the ribbon's invitation. We should review decorative influences.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it rained all evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked why you crashed my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And before that you asked whether the roads were wet. They were.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you driving too fast?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast said showers. I should answer that original question completely.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The wedding venue has made a small change.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What changed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened to the building?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.
